description: Which programs or courses match, and where? Words, a subject (CIP family, or unknown), a course subject prefix, a credential class, an award as published, and a school's state, city, type or UNITID answer with product cards (name, award, length and college when held, school and city, subject, checklist size, and what the program leads to through the CIP-SOC crosswalk) and the counts to refine by. Courses across every school need words of 3 or more characters; words held by very many courses need a state, city or school. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

award.description: Optional award exactly as published, one of the answer's awards

cip.description: Optional: programs with this six-digit CIP code (e.g. 48.0508), a comma-separated list, or an array of codes

city.description: Optional city, one of a state answer's cities

code.description: Optional, courses only: a course code as printed, e.g. ZOO 2015; lists that code at every school, or within the state, city or school given

credential.description: Optional, programs only: a credential class, one of the answer's credential values (e.g. ceterms:AssociateDegree), or none

offset.description: Optional: the next_offset from a previous answer

place.description: Optional: a place the question names, read as a state (name or code), a city, or a school, e.g. Wyoming or Casper

query.description: Words: a program's name or award, or a course's title

sector.description: Optional school type as IPEDS labels it, e.g. public 2-year

subject.description: Optional CIP family (two digits, e.g. 51) or unknown

subject_code.description: Optional: a course subject prefix, e.g. NURS, one of the answer's subject codes. A course's own prefix as printed, or a prefix a program's checklist requires

name: search_programs_and_learning_units

build_version.description: Deprecated: the same value as publish

facets.description: The refinements: each facet's values with their counts of held rows

portal_url.description: The same view on the portal

award.description: The award as published, or null

college.description: The college within the school that offers the program, when held

credits_published.description: A course's credits as printed, when held

description_excerpt.description: A course description's first 200 characters, with an ellipsis when longer; the full text is on get_learning_unit

first_edition_seen.description: The earliest academic year a source prints it in; absent for a record with one form and one source

form_statement.description: One sentence about the record's forms and sources, and whether it was last seen in an older edition

last_edition_seen.description: The latest academic year a source prints it in; absent for a record with one form and one source

leads_to.description: occupations through the CIP-SOC crosswalk; absent when none is held

normal_length.description: A program's normal length as published, when held

source_count.description: How many sources print the record; absent for a record with one form and one source

subject.description: cip_code, family, family_title, cip_source; absent when the program holds no CIP

version_count.description: How many FORMS the record holds; absent for a record with one form and one source

schools_matching.description: How many schools hold the matching set

understood.description: What was read: words, place (with candidates when several schools fit), the filters in force, question (frame, department, not_held words), lead (the product a page shows first), and match (step, words_used, stems, statement)

union_statement.description: Said once when any card carries forms or sources: the full source list is in the structured data
